title: Atlas launch weekly
scratchpad:
webinar booked
spanish docs - need quote first
load test thu
segments: Three weeks to launch. Ines, start with the webinar.
It's booked. The invite went to about four hundred contacts this morning.
The webinar is on November third at ten Pacific, one week after the launch.
Perfect. How's spend tracking against the cap?
We haven't turned on search yet, so it's just the newsletter deposits.
So far we've spent twenty one hundred of the ninety two hundred.
Good. Hana, you had something on documentation?
Yes. Two of our pilot customers run crews that mostly read Spanish.
I'd like to translate the getting started guide and the technician app help before launch.
Probably two weeks with a contractor. I don't have a quote yet.
Let's get the quote first and decide next week. I don't want to commit without a number.
On tiers: after Tuesday's pricing review the names are final. Starter, Team and Fleet.
Yes, those are locked. Put them on the page.
Engineering wants a load test before we flip the flag in production.
I'll run it Thursday at five times our current peak traffic.
Do it. Marcus, can you own the launch checklist so nothing falls through?
Sure, I'll keep the checklist and run through it every morning launch week.

items.text: Translate the getting started guide and technician app help into Spanish before launch?
Get a quote for the Spanish translation
Tier names are final: Starter, Team and Fleet
Run a load test on Thursday at 5x current peak traffic
